Acme Capital Careers

Operations Analyst

London · Full time · Job ID R-1234

Acme Capital is hiring an Operations Analyst in London. You will reconcile trades across three desks, investigate breaks before they cause losses, and automate the checks the team runs every morning.

What you will do

  • Reconcile trades and positions every day
  • Investigate and resolve breaks with the trading desks
  • Automate manual checks with Python

What we look for

  • Attention to detail and data quality
  • Python or SQL
  • Clear communication with traders and engineers

We value ownership, curiosity and getting the details right. The programme starts in September 2027 and includes training in our London office.
